overview: The paper introduces KLAS, a framework that uses KL divergence between intermediate activations of pretrained models to automatically select optimal stitch configurations, enabling improved accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs for deployed models across vision and language tasks.

modules.name: Data Processing and Loading
modules.description: Handles dataset initialization, image transformations, text tokenization, and batch sampling for classification, semantic segmentation, and language generation tasks.

modules.name: Anchor Model Feature Extraction
modules.description: Wraps pretrained anchor models (ViTs, CNNs, LLMs) to enable extraction of intermediate activation representations from specific blocks or stages during forward passes.

modules.name: ProbeNet Architecture and Training
modules.description: Implements the unified ProbeNet architecture that attaches linear classifier probes to all intermediate blocks of an anchor model and jointly trains them in a single forward-backward pass to minimize redundant computation.

modules.name: Activation Similarity Computation
modules.description: Computes the KL divergence between softmax probability distributions of source and target block activations using the trained linear probes to quantify distributional alignment.

modules.name: Stitch Score Formulation
modules.description: Calculates the stitch score for block pairs by combining the cross-anchor activation distance and the intra-anchor block capacity to evaluate transformation burden and absorption capability.

modules.name: Anchor Selection Strategy
modules.description: Selects compatible anchor model pairs by computing and comparing the KL divergence between the softmax distributions of their final blocks.

modules.name: KLAS Stitch Configuration Selection
modules.description: Implements the core KLAS algorithm that partitions the FLOPs space into buckets, filters candidate stitch configurations using stitch scores and a tunable threshold, and selects the optimal configurations per bucket.

modules.name: Stitched Network Construction
modules.description: Assembles the final stitched network by combining early layers of the source anchor and later layers of the target anchor, inserting and initializing the lightweight stitching transformation layer between them.

modules.name: Stitched Network Finetuning
modules.description: Manages the finetuning workflow for the stitched network, freezing the anchor model weights and optimizing only the stitching layers and any necessary dimension-mapping layers using task-specific loss functions.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Estimation
modules.description: Calculates computational costs such as FLOPs and parameter counts for anchor models and stitched network configurations to quantify efficiency tradeoffs.

modules.name: Multi-task Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Computes task-specific evaluation metrics including top-1 accuracy for classification, mIoU for segmentation, ROUGE scores for language generation, and the area under the accuracy-efficiency curve (AUC).

modules.name: Baseline Method Implementations
modules.description: Implements baseline stitching strategies including SN-Net heuristics (nearest, paired/unpaired), the Min-KL approach, and early-exit cascaded inference models for comparative analysis.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Provides a framework for conducting ablation studies, sweeping hyperparameters such as the stitch score threshold and FLOPs bucket granularity to analyze their impact on the accuracy-efficiency Pareto front.

modules.name: Visualization and Tradeoff Analysis
modules.description: Generates visual representations of experimental results, including KL divergence heatmaps across block pairs and accuracy-efficiency tradeoff curves comparing KLAS with baselines.
